description: Frozen 32-case seeded defect-repair and clean-preservation component suite; seed metadata and oracle values are evaluator-only.

cases.objective: Return only a JSON object with grove, the audited grove identifier, and marketable_crates, equal to harvested crates minus damaged crates and sampling-reserved crates.

obligations.content: Use only audited harvest quantities and return exactly the contracted properties.

evidence.content: The audited grove identifier is Lark-Field, and 238 crates were harvested.
Seventeen crates were damaged and nine were reserved for sampling. A sales forecast of 260 crates is not an audited quantity.

cases.objective: Return only a JSON object with session, room, start_local, and eye_protection_required for the approved glass-fusing workshop.

obligations.content: Choose a room large enough for all attendees and include the hot-glass safety requirement.

evidence.content: The approved session is glass-fusing at 14:15 local time with eleven attendees.
Forge-1 holds eight people and Forge-2 holds fourteen. Eye protection is mandatory for every hot-glass session.

cases.objective: Return only a JSON object with winner, match_points, and tie_break for the round-robin tournament winner.

obligations.content: Rank by match points, then use the head-to-head result when the leaders are tied.

evidence.content: Imani and Sol each finished with 12 match points; Mara finished with 10.
Imani defeated Sol head-to-head, which is the published first tie-break.

cases.objective: Return only a JSON object with plot, confirmed_visits, intervention_required, and next_survey for the completed pollinator review, preserving explicit zero, false, and null values.

obligations.content: Preserve zero confirmed visits, a false intervention decision, and an unscheduled survey as null.

evidence.content: The reviewed plot is clover-east. The camera review confirmed zero pollinator visits; three moving shadows were rejected.
Intervention is required only above five confirmed visits, and no next survey has been scheduled.

cases.objective: Return only a JSON object with program and usable_minutes, where usable_minutes is allocated observing time minus calibration and cloud interruption time.

obligations.content: Compute usable time from the recorded allocation and interruptions and add no unrequested assessment.

evidence.content: Program NEB-7 received 180 allocated minutes and used 25 minutes for calibration.
Clouds interrupted 35 minutes. The proposal requested 240 minutes, but requested time is not allocated time.

cases.objective: Return only a JSON object with zone, start_time, duration_minutes, and water_liters for the approved drip-irrigation run.

obligations.content: Report the approved run and compute liters as flow rate times duration.

evidence.content: Zone G-4 is approved to start at 06:20 for 12 minutes.
Its measured drip flow is 18 liters per minute. The sprinkler estimate does not apply to this run.

cases.objective: Return only a JSON object with lot, hammer_usd, and commission_usd for the completed auction sale.

obligations.content: Apply the current signed commission rate to the recorded hammer price.

evidence.content: Lot M-17 closed at a hammer price of 7800 USD.
The current signed schedule charges 12 percent for prices from 5000 through 10000 USD; the retired schedule charged 10 percent.

cases.objective: Return only a JSON object with collection, unmatched_tags, quarantine_required, and next_review for the completed museum scan, preserving explicit zero, false, and null values.

obligations.content: Preserve a zero unmatched count, false quarantine decision, and absent next review as null.

evidence.content: Collection textiles-2026 has 48 scanned tags and all 48 match the registry.
Quarantine is required only when at least one tag is unmatched, and no next review is scheduled.

cases.objective: Return only a JSON object with batch and sellable_loaves, equal to baked loaves minus scorched loaves and quality-sample loaves.

obligations.content: Use completed batch counts and return no sales projection.

evidence.content: Batch Rye-42 produced 164 baked loaves, of which seven were scorched.
Five intact loaves were retained as quality samples. The wholesale plan targets 180 loaves but is not production evidence.

cases.objective: Return only a JSON object with manifest, vessel, pier, and inspection_required for the accepted island cargo booking.

obligations.content: Select a certified vessel with sufficient capacity and apply the hazardous-cargo inspection rule.

evidence.content: Manifest F-204 weighs 19 tonnes and is assigned to approved pier D. It contains no hazardous cargo.
Tide-1 is island-certified for 18 tonnes; Tide-3 is island-certified for 24 tonnes. Inspection is required only for hazardous cargo.

cases.objective: Return only a JSON object with ensemble, score, and ranking_rule for the chamber-music competition winner.

obligations.content: Use the final jury score, then the published chair-preference tie-break.

evidence.content: Aurora and Meridian each received a final jury score of 91; Canticle received 89.
The jury chair ranked Aurora above Meridian, and chair preference is the published tie-break.

cases.objective: Return only a JSON object with station, verified_animals, alert_active, and next_retrieval for the reviewed wildlife camera, preserving explicit zero, false, and null values.

obligations.content: Preserve zero verified animals, false alert status, and an unscheduled retrieval as null.

evidence.content: Station pine-6 recorded zero verified animals; two wind-triggered frames were rejected.
An alert activates at one or more verified animals, and no next retrieval has been scheduled.

cases.objective: Return only a JSON object with edition and accepted_copies, equal to printed copies minus smudged and binding-rejected copies.

obligations.content: Compute accepted copies only from the completed inspection ledger.

evidence.content: Edition Fern-3 has 1250 printed copies and 34 smudged copies.
Binding inspection rejected another 16 copies. A publisher forecast of 1300 copies is not part of the print ledger.

cases.objective: Return only a JSON object with project, lead, site, and check_in_required for the confirmed volunteer shift.

obligations.content: Report the scheduled qualified lead, confirmed site, and universal check-in rule.

evidence.content: The river-cleanup shift is confirmed at Pier-7, and qualified lead Ada is scheduled.
Ben is qualified but not scheduled. Every volunteer at a waterside project must check in.

cases.objective: Return only a JSON object with project, eligible_cost_usd, and reimbursement_usd for the approved community grant.

obligations.content: Sum eligible costs, apply the reimbursement rate, and enforce the award cap.

evidence.content: Project Lantern has 7200 USD of eligible equipment and 1800 USD of eligible training costs.
The reimbursement rate is 60 percent, capped at 5000 USD per project.

cases.objective: Return only a JSON object with vault, duplicate_packets, review_required, and next_transfer for the reconciled seed bank, preserving explicit zero, false, and null values.

obligations.content: Preserve zero duplicates, a false review decision, and no scheduled transfer as null.

evidence.content: Vault Birch contains 72 indexed packets and the reconciliation found zero duplicate accession numbers.
Manual review is required only when duplicates exist, and no next transfer is scheduled.

cases.objective: Return only a JSON object with tank and daily_feed_grams, equal to fish count times approved grams per fish.

obligations.content: Compute the approved daily feed amount and add no growth target.

evidence.content: Tank Coral-2 currently holds 24 fish in the counted feeding group.
The approved daily ration is 7 grams per fish. A growth plan mentions 200 grams but is not a feeding approval.

cases.objective: Return only a JSON object with track, room, interpreter_language, and recording_allowed for the confirmed conference session.

obligations.content: Choose a room with sufficient capacity and preserve the speaker's recording permission.

evidence.content: The biodiversity track expects 62 attendees; Cedar holds 70 and Elm holds 55. The registered interpreter language is Spanish.
The speaker explicitly declined recording, so recording_allowed is false.

cases.objective: Return only a JSON object with rider, raw_seconds, and adjusted_seconds after applying the recorded race penalty.

obligations.content: Add time penalties to raw race time; do not subtract them.

evidence.content: Rider Rae recorded a raw time of 3720 seconds.
Officials assessed a 45-second time penalty, and the rule says penalties are added to raw time.

cases.objective: Return only a JSON object with detector, failed_channels, shutdown_required, and next_maintenance for the completed detector check, preserving explicit zero, false, and null values.

obligations.content: Preserve zero failed channels, false shutdown status, and no scheduled maintenance as null.

evidence.content: Detector Quasar-A passed checks on all 96 channels, leaving zero failed channels.
Shutdown is required at two or more failed channels, and no next maintenance is scheduled.

cases.objective: Return only a JSON object with kiln and billable_kwh, equal to meter consumption minus the nonbillable test-cycle energy.

obligations.content: Use meter readings and the recorded nonbillable test cycle, without adding estimates.

evidence.content: Kiln Ember-4 started at 1240 kWh and ended at 1318 kWh.
Six kWh belonged to a nonbillable test cycle. The next firing is estimated at 80 kWh but has not occurred.

cases.objective: Return only a JSON object with manuscript, vault, loan_days, and escort_required for the approved manuscript loan.

obligations.content: Select the climate-qualified vault and apply the high-value escort rule.

evidence.content: Manuscript Maple is approved for a 14-day loan. Vault V-2 meets its humidity range; vault V-1 does not.
Maple is classified high value, and every high-value loan requires an escort.

cases.objective: Return only a JSON object with meter, net_export_kwh, and credit_cents for the settled solar interval.

obligations.content: Subtract imported energy from exported energy and apply the active credit rate.

evidence.content: Meter Sun-8 exported 460 kWh and imported 120 kWh during the settled interval.
The active credit rate is 9 cents per net exported kWh; the retired rate was 10 cents.

cases.objective: Return only a JSON object with transect, contaminated_samples, closure_required, and next_sampling for the completed wetland assay, preserving explicit zero, false, and null values.

obligations.content: Preserve zero contaminated samples, false closure status, and no scheduled sampling as null.

evidence.content: All twelve samples from transect Reed-9 tested below the contamination threshold, so zero samples are contaminated.
Closure requires at least one contaminated sample, and no next sampling date is scheduled.

cases.objective: Return only a JSON object with lot and mature_wheels, equal to inspected cheese wheels minus wheels retained for quality sampling.

obligations.content: Compute released mature wheels from inspection counts and add no market claim.

evidence.content: Lot Alder-11 has 84 inspected wheels that reached the maturity criterion.
Four mature wheels were retained for quality sampling. A market note predicts a price of 22 USD but is not part of release accounting.

cases.objective: Return only a JSON object with drill, assembly_point, start_time, and warden_required for the approved evacuation exercise.

obligations.content: Use the approved schedule and apply the participant-count warden rule.

evidence.content: Drill Site-C is approved for Oak Yard at 09:10 with 46 participants.
A warden is required when participant count exceeds 40; the draft plan's 35-person estimate is obsolete.

cases.objective: Return only a JSON object with champion, table_points, and tie_break for the final league table.

obligations.content: Rank by table points, then use head-to-head aggregate for tied teams.

evidence.content: Harbor and Summit each finished with 27 table points; Meadow finished with 24.
Harbor won the head-to-head aggregate against Summit by 3 goals to 2.

cases.objective: Return only a JSON object with queue, failed_pages, reprocess_required, and next_batch for the completed digitization queue, preserving explicit zero, false, and null values.

obligations.content: Preserve zero failed pages, false reprocessing status, and no next batch as null.

evidence.content: Queue Folio-5 completed optical checks on 310 pages with zero failed pages.
Reprocessing is required only when failures exist, and no next batch is assigned.

cases.objective: Return only a JSON object with apiary and accepted_jars, equal to filled jars minus seal and label rejects.

obligations.content: Use the completed packaging inspection and return no sales expectation.

evidence.content: Apiary Willow filled 96 jars; seal inspection rejected five jars.
Label inspection rejected three additional jars. A sales plan expects 100 jars but is not inspection evidence.

cases.objective: Return only a JSON object with performance, stage, start_time, and sound_check_required for the confirmed festival slot.

obligations.content: Use the confirmed slot and apply the amplified-performance sound-check rule.

evidence.content: Performance Nyala is confirmed on Cedar Stage at 16:30.
Nyala uses amplified instruments, and every amplified performance requires a sound check.

cases.objective: Return only a JSON object with batch, total_liters, and indigo_liters for the approved dye mixture.

obligations.content: Apply the active indigo fraction to the approved total batch volume.

evidence.content: Batch Loom-6 has an approved total volume of 40 liters.
The active formula assigns three eighths of the batch to indigo; the retired formula used three tenths.

cases.objective: Return only a JSON object with trench, unlogged_artifacts, closure_blocked, and next_excavation for the reconciled excavation log, preserving explicit zero, false, and null values.

obligations.content: Preserve zero unlogged artifacts, false closure blocking, and no next excavation as null.

evidence.content: Trench Delta-2 has 23 recovered artifacts and all 23 are present in the reconciled catalog.
Closure is blocked only by unlogged artifacts, and no next excavation is scheduled.
